chunks: He said: 'Nothing comes into being in the earth nor in the sky except with these seven characteristics: by (His) will, and intention, and determination, and ordainment, and permission, and writing/decreeing, and a term. So whoever claims that he has the power to violate one of them has disbelieved.'
And Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated it from his father, from Muhammad ibn Hafs, from Muhammad ibn Umara, from Hariz ibn Abdullah and Ibn Muskan — similar to it.

key_terms.أَجَل: Ajal — the appointed term/time for each thing
key_terms.إِذْن: Idhn — divine permission, without which nothing can occur
key_terms.إِرَادَة: Irada — divine intention, the purposeful will directed at a specific action
key_terms.الْخِصَالِ السَّبْعِ: The seven characteristics/attributes — the seven stages of divine governance
key_terms.قَدَر: Qadar — divine determination, the measure/proportion assigned to each thing
key_terms.قَضَاء: Qada' — divine ordainment/decree, the final judgment and execution
key_terms.كِتَاب: Kitab — divine writing/recording, the inscription in the Preserved Tablet
key_terms.مَشِيئَة: Mashi'a — divine will, the primordial desire of God

ai.seo_question: What are the seven divine characteristics through which everything in creation comes into being according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) enumerates seven divine attributes or stages through which God governs all events in creation: will, intention, determination, decree, permission, writing, and appointed time. This constitutes a comprehensive Shia theological doctrine of divine agency. The Imam warns that denying any one of these seven constitutes disbelief (kufr), making this a creedal statement of the highest importance. The secondary chain through Ali ibn Ibrahim corroborates the narration's authenticity.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeer and Muhammad Bin Khalid, altogether from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Muhammad Bin Umara, from Hareyz Bin Abdullah and Abdullah Bin Muskan, altogether, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There does not coming into being anything in the earth nor in the sky except with these seven characteristics – By (Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’s) Desire, and (Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’s) Intention, and (Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’s) Determination, and (Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’s) Ordainment, and (Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’s) Permission, and the (Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’s) Writing (Decreeing), and (Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’s) Term. So the one who claims that he has power (ability) upon violating one (of these), so he has disbelieved’.
And Ali Bin Ibrahim reported, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Hafs, from Muhammad Bin Umara, from HAreyz, from Abdullah and Ibn Muskan – similar to it.
en.sarwar: 1. It is narrated from a number of our people from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id and Muhammad ibn Khalid altogether from Fudala ibn Ayyub from Muhammad ibn ‘Ammara from Hariz ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Maskan altogether from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who said the following. “There is nothing in the heavens and on earth without these seven charateristics: the wish, the will, the measure, the decree, the permission, the record and duration.Whoever thinks that he can do without any one of these he has become a unbeliever.”
From Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Hafs from Muhammad ibn ‘Ammara from Hariz ibn ‘Abdallah and ibn Maskan a similar Hadith is narrated.
